seriesTitle: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen

episodes.title: Never Get On One Knee
episodes.summary: Rachel and Nicky kick off their wedding week with a drive to his parents' secluded home — but end up taking a few detours.

episodes.title: Bride-Shaped Hole
episodes.summary: When Rachel's wedding dress mysteriously goes missing, her in-laws are all too eager to provide an alternative.

episodes.title: I Will Light You on Fire
episodes.summary: Rachel is tasked with taking down the Cunninghams' meal preferences — and discovers a lot more than she expected.

episodes.title: The Witness
episodes.summary: When a new chapter in her family history comes to light, Rachel learns that love means sometimes having to say you're sorry.

episodes.title: I Think You Just Saved My Life
episodes.summary: Rachel and Nicky's romantic origin story is the talk of the rehearsal dinner — until they're forced to make a few revisions.

episodes.title: Last Night of Freedom
episodes.summary: The bachelors hunt and the bachelorettes gather, but the party's definitely over.

episodes.title: Something Living, Something Dead, Something Stolen, Something Red
episodes.summary: With the ceremony just an hour away, Rachel finds herself in serious need of a drink.
